title: ERC-8004 feedback with proof of payment after an x402 payment
summary: A client agent pays a seller agent through x402, writes an off-chain feedback file that carries proofOfPayment, uploads it, and only then calls giveFeedback with the file URI and hash. The registry stores value, decimals and tags; the proof stays off-chain and nobody on-chain checks it.

steps.label: Pay for a call with x402
steps.detail: The client finds the seller through its registration file (x402Support true, MCP service) and pays with x402. ERC-8004 is not involved: the payment is orthogonal to the registries.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version x402 v2.0.
GET /weather?city=Lisbon HTTP/1.1
Host: mcp.agent.example
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: eyJ4NDAyVmVyc2lvbiI6Mi...

steps.label: Verify and settle
steps.detail: The seller asks its facilitator to verify and settle. The payee is the address the agent advertises as agentWallet; the facilitator broadcasts the transfer.

steps.label: Return 200 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE
steps.detail: The response carries the settlement result with the transaction hash, which becomes the txHash in proofOfPayment.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version x402 v2.0.
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
PAYMENT-RESPONSE: eyJzdWNjZXNzIjp0cnVlLCJ0cmFuc2FjdGlvbiI6IjB4NWU1ZS4uLiJ9

steps.label: Upload feedback file with proofOfPayment
steps.detail: The client writes the feedback file first: the MUST fields (agentRegistry, agentId, clientAddress, createdAt, value, valueDecimals) plus optional tags, endpoint, mcp context and proofOfPayment {fromAddress, toAddress, chainId, txHash}.

steps.label: Compute feedbackHash
steps.detail: feedbackHash is keccak256 of the file content. For a content-addressed URI such as IPFS it is optional and may be bytes32(0).

steps.label: giveFeedback(agentId, value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2, endpoint, feedbackURI, feedbackHash)
steps.detail: Only value and valueDecimals are required. The registry stores value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2 and isRevoked under the next feedbackIndex for this client. The proof of payment is not an argument and is never stored on-chain.

failures.condition: The caller is the owner or an operator of the agent

steps.label: Return NewFeedback event
steps.detail: The event carries agentId, clientAddress, feedbackIndex, value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2, endpoint, feedbackURI and feedbackHash. The contract does not store endpoint, feedbackURI and feedbackHash; on-chain they appear only in this event and in the transaction calldata.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
NewFeedback(agentId=123456789, clientAddress=0xA11C...A11C, feedbackIndex=1, value=87, valueDecimals=0,
  tag1="starred", tag2="", endpoint="https://mcp.agent.example/",
  feedbackURI="ipfs://bafy...feedback", feedbackHash=0x00...00)

steps.label: Fetch the file and check the proof
steps.detail: A reader that wants payment-backed feedback fetches the file, compares its hash, and looks up txHash on the named chain to confirm the amount and the payee. The registry does none of this.

failures.condition: The file is gone or its hash does not match
failures.outcome: The on-chain value still counts in getSummary; only off-chain scoring can discount it.

failures.condition: The txHash does not exist or pays someone else
failures.outcome: Nothing on-chain flags it; the reader must reject it.
